description: Defines core debug logging functions for the Starboard platform, including log levels, logging functions (raw, formatted, stack dump), and related utilities.

methods.name: SbLog
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority to the platform's debug output.

methods.name: SbLogRaw
methods.description: Logs a raw message in an async-signal-safe manner.

methods.name: SbLogRawDumpStack
methods.description: Dumps the current thread's stack trace in an async-signal-safe manner.

methods.name: SbLogRawFormat
methods.description: Logs a formatted message in an async-signal-safe manner using va_list.

methods.name: SbLogRawFormatF
methods.description: Inline wrapper for SbLogRawFormat, accepts variadic arguments.

methods.name: SbLogFormat
methods.description: Logs a formatted message with string formatting.

methods.name: SbLogFormatF
methods.description: Inline wrapper for SbLogFormat, accepts variadic arguments.

methods.name: SbLogIsTty
methods.description: Indicates if the log output is a TTY or redirected.
